"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Changes in conditions resulted from governments’ and corporations’ response to a crisis of profitability that culminated in attacks on labor and social and economic protections.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Private debt is growing.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Wages have declined in real terms or failed to increase with productivity.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Public austerity and incarceration endanger communities and make it difficult for many people to pay for rent, food, childcare, or housing.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Class and regional disparities in health, education, and infrastructure have widened.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The fundamental divides of racial capitalism have deepened.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"An economy increasingly based around financial speculation will not provide for human needs.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"An economy increasingly based around financial speculation will not deliver essential goods like pharmaceuticals, healthcare, and safe transportation.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
